fieldValues.title: relation create rejects the canonical $schema-bearing carrier
fieldValues.summary: srs relation create parsed input directly into srs_core::types::relation::Relation (deny_unknown_fields, no $schema field), but the canonical standalone relation.json schema requires $schema (RFC-038 Change E). A producer holding already schema-valid Relation JSON (round-tripped from relation get, or migration tooling) hit "unknown field `$schema`" instead of a successful create. Added relation_service::parse_relation_input (strips/validates a matching $schema before deserializing) and routed both the CLI and the WASM binding through it. Stored objects' own $schema handling (store::relation_object_to_value/from_value) is untouched.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/pull/1051. Prove stage: reverted the CLI fix, reran the new relation_create_accepts_canonical_schema_pointer test, confirmed it failed red with the exact reported error, then restored the fix. Gates green: cargo build/test/clippy -D warnings (SRS_SPEC_DIR pointed at a fresh origin/master clone for the parity tests), payload_contracts. gate:auto-merge armed (SQUASH); issue relabelled gate:working -> gate:in-review.
